source_preservation.scope: 88 canonical entrypoints and frozen original 83/450 baseline contracts with directed adaptations

review_interface_forward_use.scope: Two fresh gpt-6.1-sol/high sessions; actual consumer checks, source-integrity checks and parent same-family artifact assessment; not a matched comparison or population estimate

multi_wave_practical_use.scope: One warm-project real-data continuation; independent parent readback code, same-family provisional evidence review. Later guidance changes tested separately. Old failures and external interruption remain.

prior_native_ci.scope: Ubuntu/macOS and powershell.exe/pwsh before later uncommitted runtime and guidance repairs; not current-source CI

new_commit_native_ci.scope: New commit must pass Ubuntu/macOS full suites and both Windows shell gates; earlier passes do not override the failed tag run.

formal_installation.scope: Temporary dev9/dev10 evaluation installs removed; the user has authorized committing 1.5.0, no formal installation replacement performed

previous_local_suite_before_checkpoint_f.scope: Source before the newly discovered Windows cleanup-sharing repair; 1269 passing tests do not certify the later fix.

final_full_local_suite.scope: Filesystem-local snapshot: 1064 tracked files matched at dispatch. Unchanged Grok bridge progress/cancellation test exceeded its three-second first-message wait. Later notes and validation edits are separate. Checkpoint repair tests passed; this full run remains failed.

accepted_submission_native_ci.scope: Four passing platform jobs on the original submission. A later tag run exposed Windows cleanup sharing contention.

first_publication_attempt.failure: Native Windows powershell.exe: WinError 32 during journaled old-checkpoint removal while a monitoring reader held state.json. Other three platform jobs passed; publication was skipped.

checkpoint_rotation_repair.scope: Real publication/rotation with deterministic simulated sharing errors, partial deletion, persistent/permanent error bounds, recovery and journal retry; includes a Windows-only real open-handle test for native CI. Two new tests fail against original source as expected.

unchanged_bridge_recheck.scope: Separate unchanged invocation of all Grok bridge tests. Does not erase the full-suite timeout or establish its frequency or root cause.

limitations: Public development fixtures and same-family assessments do not establish independent scientific acceptance.
No general superiority over 1.4.0, full RSI or unattended research over hours or days is established.
Earlier timeouts, infrastructure interruption, no-clear-gain comparison and failed probes remain in source-specific records.
Initial setup and warm continuation costs are distinct; no portable speedup claim.
Local validation receipts are intentionally ignored and not bundled in source assets; repository validation records preserve scopes and local receipt hashes.
Native macOS/Windows results from the ancestor do not certify later changes.
Optional external providers, distributed training, network filesystems and power-loss recovery are not newly guaranteed.
